name: neo-brutalist
title: Neo Brutalist
description: Stark ink borders, unblurred offset shadows, compact type, and deliberate high-saturation accents without decorative effects.
rules: Use solid 2px ink borders and hard offset shadows; blur, glow, and soft ambient elevation are forbidden.
Reserve the orange accent for one dominant action per region and pair it with dark text.
Keep surfaces opaque and rectangular; rounding is allowed only for compact pill labels.
Translate pressed controls by the shadow offset while reducing the shadow to zero.
Set display copy flush left in bold or black weight with tight tracking.
Use no more than regular, bold, and black weights in a component tree.
Maintain the 4px spacing scale and include the border and shadow thickness in alignment calculations.
Never combine multiple saturated accent colors in the same component tree.
Apply tabular numerals to counters and right-align numeric data.
Use immediate or 100ms stepped transitions; avoid spring, floating, pulsing, and ambient animation.
